definitions.explanation: A machine that automatically washes dishes. Short for {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}. Increasingly common in Japanese households.

examples.japanese: {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧で⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Our dishwasher is quiet and convenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{備|そな}え{付|つ}けて⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The new kitchen has a built-in dishwasher.

notes:
Abbreviation of ⟦{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}→食器洗い機：04673_shokkiaraiki⟧ (dish-washing machine). This shortened form is the most common way to refer to a dishwasher in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ — dishwasher-safe
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ — to load the dishwasher
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ — to run the dishwasher
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ — dishwasher detergent
- ビルトイン{食洗機|しょくせんき} — built-in dishwasher

USAGE:
While traditionally less common in Japanese homes than in Western countries, dishwashers have become increasingly popular. Product labels and instructions often use {食洗機|しょくせんき}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ to indicate an item is dishwasher-safe.
